name: Osmium Links
description: A list of external links (name, address, short description, logo) managed in admin, optionally in groups, for a theme to show anywhere

setup.postInstallNote: Add links under Content > Links, optionally giving each a group such as Brands or Suppliers. A theme controller reads them: $links = new \Osmium\Services\OsmiumLinks\Models\Links($this->osmium->dataSource); $links->all() for one list, or $links->grouped() for group name => links (ungrouped links come first under the key ''). Each link has name, url, description and logo (a site-relative path, or null). The theme prints the markup; add rel="noopener" (and nofollow if wanted) to the anchors. Uploaded logos are saved in assets/images/links/.
